issue_context.title: If route.queryParamMap contains an array as a param it leads to trigger queryParamMap observable even if any params are not changed
issue_context.body:
# 🐞 bug report ### Affected Package The issue is caused by package @angular/router ### Is this a regression? No ### Description If route.queryParamMap contains an array as a param it leads to trigger `queryParamMap ` observable even if any `params` are not changed. Steps to reproduce: 1. Open https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-1qdje4 1. Open console (dev console) in stackblitz. 1. Click on link "Go to parent component". In console will be displayed message from `route.queryParamMap` observable handler. 1. Click on link "Go to child component". **Actual result:** In console again will be displayed message from `route.queryParamMap` observable handler. The second link "Go to child component" has attribute `[queryParamsHandling]="'preserve'"`. It means that queryParams will be the same as on current route and `route.queryParamMap` observable shouldn't be triggered. **Expected result:** `route.queryParamMap` observable shouldn't be triggered. P.S. If we change attribute of link "Go to parent component" from `[queryParams]="{item: [1, 2, 3]}"` to `[queryParams]="{item: 1}"`, i.e. make value of `item` as primitive type it works as expected: `route.queryParamMap` observable is not triggered. ## 🔬 Minimal Reproduction https://stackblitz.com/edit/angular-1qdje4 ## 🌍 Your Environment **Angular Version:** 

Angular CLI: 8.1.0
Node: 12.10.0
OS: win32 x64
